cards.card_text: He calls it "the salt of the covenant of your God," and it goes in every offering.
cards.verse_text: And you shall season each of your grain offerings with salt. You must not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offering; you are to add salt to each of your offerings. If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, you shall offer crushed heads of new grain roasted on the fire.
